content: Insight/report generators for metrics-to-NL: (1) Template-based sectioned output per-function or per-domain with concrete numbers; (2) Cite specific values: 'Coverage: 78% (OB Picking) vs 52% (Receiving)' not generic statements; (3) Delta framing when a re-solve occurred: 'Before override: 3 unmet hours. After: 1 unmet hour'; (4) Faithfulness constraint: only state what metrics data supports; (5) Structured prompt with JSON metrics input -> NL sections is the dominant pattern; (6) Post-run separation is standard -- insight generation happens after successful solve so LLM failure cannot invalidate the schedule.
